response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, technically diverse individual contributor with deep developer-tooling and testing experience (test runners, CI/CD, DevOps infra, open-source frameworks), but his resume shows no evidence of people management or team leadership — all roles are IC titles (Senior/Staff/Software Developer) with no mention of managing reports, conducting performance reviews, or leading organizational change. This is a management role requiring 2+ years of people leadership, which is not demonstrated here.
strengths: Deep, hands-on experience building developer tools, test frameworks, and CI/CD infrastructure
Broad technical range across web, mobile, embedded, and systems programming, fitting the productivity-tooling focus
Experience running workshops and mentoring/teaching, showing some knowledge-sharing leadership
concerns: No evidence of formal people management or direct reports in any role
No mention of setting team roadmaps, performance expectations, or leading organizational change
No mobile-platform-specific or large-scale platform ecosystem experience relevant to the role's focus

key_factors.factor: No organizational leadership or roadmap-setting evidence
